Lina (Design): Quick mini-review of embeddings preview after yesterday's usability test. Small items: toolbar order, export wording, keyboard flow for the table. Figma: https://figma.com/preview :mag:

Ben (Frontend): I think toolbar should be [Re-rank] (primary) -> [Columns] -> [Export]. Most flows hit rerank straight from preview. Also proposing a keyboard shortcut: Shift+R to trigger rerank when focus is inside the table (opt-out in prefs).

Priya (Product): Agree on "Re-rank results" as primary label. For export copy: use "Export CSV" and in modal header "Export results ormat and columns" with helper "Scores included by default". For privacy customers we should surface a clear toggle to exclude context.

Omar (A11y): A11y notes: primary button must have aria-describedby pointing to the model label so screen readers announce e.g., "Re-rank results. Model: text-embed-v1.2". Avoid single-letter shortcuts; Shift+R is okay if documented and disable-able. Toolbar should be a single composite widget to reduce tab stops.

Maya (Data): CSV locale issue: add radio choices [Comma (CSV)] [Semicolon (CSV - Excel)] [Tab (TSV)] in export modal. Backend will accept `delimiter` and ordered `fields` param; front-end should send fields in UI order. We'll accept `delimiter=auto` for Accept-Language detection later.

Ben (Frontend): Implementation notes: export modal will include checkbox "Include similarity score and rank" (default checked) and a small toggle "Include source context" (default off). We'll add an ARIA live region announcing when context export is enabled.

Lina (Design): UX microcopy decisions: primary = "Re-rank results", export CTA = "Export CSV", export helper = "Scores included by default. Toggle to exclude source context." Add tiny model badge next to table title.

ui-bot: Created INF-5102 "batch-preview export fields & delimiter" and linked to thread.

Ben (Frontend): I'll ship a prototype branch with toolbar reorder and modal updates this week.

Priya (Product): I'll review copy and the privacy toggle tonight.

Omar (A11y): I'll send the aria snippet and keyboard spec by tomorrow.

Lina (Design): Thanks team! I'll update the Figma and ping when ready for review. :+1:
